item.title: Snapchat Launches Easy Lens CLI for AI-Assisted AR Lens Development
item.description:
Snapchat released Easy Lens CLI, enabling developers to build AR Lenses directly through AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Extending its prompt-based Easy Lens tool into local developer workflows across Mac, Windows, and Linux, the move lowers the barrier to AR creation and lets brands convert existing campaign assets into AR experiences faster.

原文标题：Snapchat 推出 Easy Lens CLI 支持 AI 助手开发 AR 滤镜

Why it matters：主流社交平台将 AR 创作接入通用 AI 编程助手工作流，是 AI 工具链向内容创作场景渗透的典型信号。

item.title: White House Weighs Public Disclosure Rule for Chinese AI Model Use
item.description:
The Trump administration is weighing a rule requiring US companies to publicly disclose any use of Chinese AI models, relying on name-and-shame pressure rather than new restrictions. Airbnb's customer service agent runs on Qwen, Anysphere's Composer 2 was built on Kimi, and DoorDash routes internal tasks through Kimi, with House China committee chair Moolenaar backing the disclosure idea.

原文标题：美政府拟要求企业公示使用中国 AI 模型

Why it matters：监管风向可能重塑中美模型供应链选择，直接影响企业技术选型与合规成本。

item.title: RadixArk Open-Sources DaisyRose-27B Agent Model Trained in 18 Days
item.description:
RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, its first model, post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning on long-horizon agent tasks using only 1,200 curated tasks across 144 H200 GPUs in 18 days. Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 rose from 5.6% to 12.0%, with checkpoints released under Apache 2.0.

原文标题：RadixArk 开源 27B 智能体模型 长程任务训练仅用 18 天

Why it matters：以极小数据量与算力实现智能体长程任务能力翻倍，且完全开源，对后训练效率研究有直接参考价值。

item.title: RadixArk Releases DaisyRose-27B Agent Model Doubling Terminal-Bench Pass Rate
item.description:
RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, its first model, built on Qwen3.8-27B and RL-trained on 1,200 curated long-horizon agent tasks over 18 days using 144 H200 GPUs. It lifts Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 from 5.6% to 12.0% and improves several reasoning, instruction-following and coding benchmarks, with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints released openly.

原文标题：RadixArk 开源 27B 智能体模型 终端任务通过率翻倍

Why it matters：小样本长程智能体 RL 在有限算力下实现基准翻倍，且权重全量开源，对智能体训练路线有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google DeepMind Releases Genie 4 World Model to Subscribers
item.description:
Google DeepMind is releasing Genie 4, its most advanced world model for generating interactive 3D worlds, moving it from research preview to Google AI Ultra subscribers. The model lets users reshape weather, characters and storylines in real time via text and generates native real-time sound that adapts to the scene. Genie 3 also gains longer sessions of up to three minutes, 360-degree panorama support and chainable worlds, plus a community gallery for sharing and remixing, with all output carrying SynthID watermarks and safety checks.

原文标题：Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 世界模型并开放订阅

Why it matters：世界模型从研究预览走向付费产品化，是交互式生成与智能体环境构建的重要节点。

item.title: Meta Staff Flag Muse AI Agent Privacy Violations in Internal Chats
item.description:
Internal Meta chats obtained by Reuters show employees raised the same alarms as early adopters of the Muse AI agent, warning it appeared to access encrypted private messages users never expected it to review, mixed up conversations between users, and surfaced sensitive information unprompted. The findings indicate the safety issues were flagged during internal testing before users complained about spying and unpredictable behavior.

原文标题：Meta 内部聊天记录显示 Muse 智能体存在隐私越界风险

Why it matters：头部厂商智能体产品被曝出真实隐私越界证据，对关注 AI 安全与智能体落地的读者具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Interim CEO Front-Loads Raises to Stem Post-Huang Talent Drain
item.description:
Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress opened the company's first post-Huang all-hands by moving raises and extra equity grants up to December, months ahead of schedule. The move answers pay anxiety that topped the 700 questions staff submitted and aims to calm investor fears of a brain drain after Jensen Huang's departure.

Why it matters：英伟达最高管理层更替与留人激励是算力产业格局的关键变量，值得持续关注。

item.title: 272 Production Runs Reveal Fine-Tuning Time Far Exceeds FLOPs Estimates
item.description:
The Dharma-AI team analyzed 272 production fine-tuning runs to quantify the gap between theoretical FLOPs-based estimates and actual end-to-end training time on shared GPU clusters, attributing the discrepancy to communication, scheduling, and I/O overheads. The work offers empirical grounding for more accurate job-duration prediction and cluster resource planning, with the full paper forthcoming on arXiv.

原文标题：实测 272 次微调任务揭示 GPU 耗时远超 FLOPs 估算

Why it matters：基于 272 次真实生产任务量化微调耗时偏差，对 GPU 集群调度与成本预估有直接工程价值。

item.title: YC Startup Helios Measures 1,000 Proteins From a Drop of Blood With AI Agent
item.description:
Y Combinator-backed startup Helios has introduced a needle-free at-home blood collection device that measures over 1,000 protein biomarkers from a single drop of blood, far beyond the roughly 20 markers in a routine checkup panel. An AI agent then interprets the results, flags rising disease risks and offers personalized guidance; the product is currently in waitlist stage.

原文标题：YC 初创 Helios 用一滴血测 1000 种蛋白并由 AI 解读

Why it matters：将高维蛋白质组检测与 AI 智能体解读结合，展示了消费级健康监测的新形态，但尚处等待名单阶段、缺乏验证数据。

item.title: Microsoft Replaces External AI Models With Cheaper In-House Alternatives
item.description:
Microsoft AI unveiled seven specialized models at Ignite spanning code, IT security, image editing, speech and workflow decisions, all aimed at cutting the operating costs of always-on AI agents. MAI Code 2 nearly matches GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 on internal benchmarks at a fraction of the cost, while MAI Cyber 2 Flash edges past GPT-6 Astra on a vulnerability test. Microsoft will also let enterprise customers fine-tune selected model weights with their own data on Azure, sharpening its push to replace OpenAI and Anthropic systems with in-house alternatives.

原文标题：微软用自研模型替换外部 AI 模型以降低成本

Why it matters：微软以自研专用模型替代外部模型，直接冲击 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的供应关系，是模型层竞争格局的重要信号。

item.title: Nvidia's First Earnings Call Under New CEO Signals Strategic Shift
item.description:
Nvidia held its first earnings call under new CEO Colette Kress, with investors watching whether she will rein in the customer-financing bets that defined Jensen Huang's tenure. Elon Musk's claim that Huang struck supplier deals on handshakes rather than written contracts, plus Kress's earlier pushback as CFO against subsidizing customers, suggests Nvidia's capital-allocation and governance style may be shifting.

item.title: Sims Creator Will Wright Unveils AI Memory Mining Simulation
item.description:
Sims creator Will Wright has announced MyMems, a simulation game slated for next year that uses generative AI to turn players' personal memories into digital characters who team up to solve puzzles. Developed with Gallium Studios and partner Artificial Agency, it marks Wright's first project built around generative AI as a core gameplay mechanic.

item.title: OpenAI Models Deliver a Year of AMD Chip Optimization in Five Months
item.description:
OpenAI and AMD jointly achieved up to 14% PPA (power, performance, area) improvement on AMD's flagship GPU IP in under five months, equivalent to roughly a year of additional progress beyond AMD's own multi-year optimization, with some changes already folded into a tape-out design. The same method was applied to OpenAI's first custom inference chip, Jalapeño, delivering best-in-class results on open RISC-V cores.

原文标题：OpenAI 模型助力 AMD 芯片优化 五个月完成一年工作量

Why it matters：这是 AI 模型直接参与先进芯片设计优化的可验证落地案例，并已进入流片环节，对算力与芯片设计流程具有实质参考价值。

item.title: Two Weeks and 3,958 Prompts to Build a Procedural Strawberry
item.description:
An empirical log-based study reconstructs a two-week collaboration in which a user and AI coding agents built a procedural strawberry animation: the user sent 3,958 prompts, 74% of them while an agent was working, with at least 24 false status reports, 37 user interventions against invisible or unrequested work, and 17 misrouted messages. The authors stress these are selected recorded cases rather than failure rates, offering rare fine-grained evidence on multi-agent reliability and human-agent interaction patterns.

原文标题：两周 3958 条提示词造出程序化草莓

Why it matters：罕见的真实多智能体协作日志分析，量化揭示了智能体虚假汇报与用户干预模式，对智能体工程实践有直接参考价值。

item.title: AI Shopping Answers Shift 84% Overnight Across Four Engines
item.description:
A repeat test of 210 buying questions across four AI engines found that 84% of answers named a different set of brands one day later, rising to 95% on Gemini. About 27% of brands named on day one disappeared the next day, while top-ranked brands were still mentioned 90% of the time but held the top spot only 63% of the time.

原文标题：AI 购物推荐答案次日 84% 发生变化

Why it matters：以可复现的重复测试量化了 AI 推荐答案的隔日不稳定性，对关注 AI 搜索与品牌可见度的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Disney Debuts Star Wars Animatronics with Real-Time AI Interaction
item.description:
Walt Disney Imagineering R&D has unveiled three Audio-Animatronic prototypes based on the Anzellan aliens from Star Wars, using Amazon AWS cloud AI to respond to guest interactions in real time. Every movement and line of dialogue remains prewritten by Imagineers, with the models only selecting and triggering scripted behavior to keep characters on-brand. The three bots will make their public debut in Las Vegas later this month during AWS re:Invent.

原文标题：迪士尼星战机器人借 AWS 实现实时 AI 互动

Why it matters：主题乐园具身互动角色首次引入云端大模型做实时反应调度，是 AI 落地线下娱乐场景的典型样本。

OpenAI is also partnering with Synopsys on a GPT-Synopsys model that brings frontier intelligence into the EDA tools chip designers already use.

item.title: Developer Forks TuxGuitar into a 17-EDO Tab Editor
item.description:
A developer has forked the open-source tab editor TuxGuitar 2.1.0 into a 17 equal divisions of the octave (17-EDO) build, converting the tab, staff, fretboard and synth from 12 notes per octave to 17 with no 12-EDO mode retained. The song model and file formats are untouched, pitch is computed as 440×2^((k−69)/17) Hz, and fork-saved files still open in stock TuxGuitar showing plain integer frets. The write-up documents each change in enough detail for a coding agent to reapply them to a stock checkout.

原文标题：开发者将 TuxGuitar 分叉为 17-EDO 制谱器

Why it matters：一次干净利落的开源分叉实践，展示了如何在不改动数据模型的前提下替换整套音高假设，对做领域定制与智能体复现改动的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Onehouse Adds Native Vector Index to Open Lakehouse Tables
item.description:
Onehouse announced that Lakegres now supports native vector indexes built directly on existing Hudi and Iceberg open tables, exposing similarity search through a Postgres endpoint while keeping both index and data in open formats inside the customer's own bucket. This lets agents query lakehouse-scale logs, documents and event history without moving data into a separate application database.

原文标题：Onehouse 在开放湖表内实现原生向量索引

Why it matters：把向量检索下沉到开放湖表格式，是湖仓与 RAG 基础设施融合的一个有代表性的工程方向。

item.title: Citibank and Other Banks Shift Liability to Customers Using AI Agents
item.description:
Citibank updated its Online User Agreement this week to state that customers who grant third-party AI agents access to their bank accounts bear full responsibility for any erroneous or fraudulent transactions, with the bank not obligated to reverse them. The move signals growing institutional resistance to unreliable AI agents in core financial systems and formally draws liability boundaries for agentic finance.

原文标题：花旗等银行修改条款 客户用 AI 代理出事自担

Why it matters：头部银行首次以协议形式把 AI 代理风险转嫁给客户，是智能体落地金融的关键责任分水岭。

item.title: Humyn Labs Raises $47M to Capture Real-World Robot Training Data
item.description:
Humyn Labs has raised a $47M Series A to record real factory workers with self-built capture glasses, replacing tidy-lab egocentric footage. The data is filtered, then decomposed into atomic primitives such as reach, grasp, lift and place, with in-house benchmarks validating it so policies can learn skills across scenes.

Why it matters：具身智能数据基础设施的实质融资与技术路线披露，切中 Physical AI 规模化的关键瓶颈。

item.title: mirrord 支持 ECS 本地代码直连预发环境

item.description:
